exposure: First-trimester prescription of Kampo medicine containing Prunus persica kernel (KPK)
cohort: Pregnant women in Japan enrolled with the same healthcare insurer from 3 months before pregnancy to delivery, who gave birth between 2010 and 2019, with data linked to their infants.
finding: There was no significant difference in the risk of preterm birth or major congenital malformations between pregnant women prescribed KPK and those prescribed TSS during the first trimester.
